title: Beachfront House Beats in Danang
description: Transition from the fairways to the shoreline. Danang's premier beachfront clubs offer fire shows, international DJs, and barefoot luxury right on the sand.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Danang's beachfront clubs, inspired by Bali and Ibiza, offer a 4-hour "barefoot luxury" experience featuring craft cocktails at sunset, a 9 PM fire-dancing show, and international deep house DJs. This experience is ideally paired with a round at BRG Danang.
> *   Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for these year-round beachfront club experiences in Danang. Advance booking is strictly required.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Transition from the fairways to the shoreline. Danang's premier beachfront clubs offer fire shows, international DJs, and barefoot luxury right on the sand.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Borrowing from the legendary beach club culture of Bali and Ibiza, operators in Danang have carved out premium enclaves on the city's pristine coastline.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Pre-book a VIP cabana right on the beach. Arrive at sunset for craft cocktails. As the night progresses, a professional fire-dancing show is performed on the sand at 9 PM. International resident DJs take over the decks, playing deep house as the ocean crashes in the background.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Tropical, Energetic, Barefoot Luxury |
| **Duration** | 4 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | An evening following a round at BRG Danang. |

## From Coastal Links Bunkers to Barefoot Cabanas Along My Khe & Non Nuoc Beach
Stretching from My Khe Beach south past Non Nuoc toward Hoi An, Da Nang’s 30-kilometer white-sand coastline links every major Central Coast golf resort—including [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Norman Course)](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), [BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-nicklaus/), [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/), and [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/)—directly to the city’s premier beachfront lounge enclaves (*Esco Beach*, *Maia Beach Bar*, and the coastal beach clubs linking Da Nang to Hoi An’s An Bang shore). For groups traveling on [The Coastal Sprint](/tours/the-coastal-sprint/) or [Da Nang & Hoi An Coastal Links](/tours/da-nang-hoi-an-coastal-links/), booking a front-row oceanfront cabana from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM delivers effortless "barefoot 19th hole" recovery without needing formal jackets or long transfers.

## VIP Daybed Reservations, Fire Shows & Resort Proximity
* **Zero-Friction Distance From Golf & Resorts:** The beach club strip sits 10 to 15 minutes north of [BRG Da Nang](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/), [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/), and [TIA Wellness Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/tia-wellness-resort-danang/), and 5 minutes from [M Hotel Danang](/accommodations/vietnam/m-hotel-danang/) and [Chicland Danang Beach Hotel](/accommodations/vietnam/chicland-da-nang/).
* **Sunset Tapas to 9:00 PM Fire Choreography:** Arrive at 5:30 PM as the East Sea breeze cools the sand, settle into a pre-reserved ocean-edge daybed with magnum rosé, wood-fired seafood platters, and passionfruit mojitos, and watch the 9:00 PM beach fire-dancing performance accompanied by live saxophonists and deep-house DJs.
* **Two-Stage Nightlife Option:** Groups wanting to keep the celebration rolling after the 9:30 PM beach fire show can step into their waiting AGS luxury private touring vehicle for a 10-minute hop over the Han River to [Sky36 Danang](/destinations/vietnam/vietnam-nightlife-sky36-danang/).

## Seamless Private Villa & Resort Connectivity Along the Da Nang Coast
Whether your golf group is unpacking once in a multi-bedroom beachfront pool residence like [An Bang Holiday Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/) or [An Bang Salt Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/), or staying at [Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang](/accommodations/vietnam/fusion-resort-villa-da-nang/), [TIA Wellness Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/tia-wellness-resort-danang/), or [InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](/accommodations/vietnam/intercontinental-danang/), our dedicated evening MPVs remain on standby outside the beach club entrance so your fourballs can move effortlessly from afternoon rounds at [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/) and [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/) to oceanfront cabanas and back. For tournament groups celebrating nearest-the-pin and individual Stableford honors, our concierge can also arrange custom beachfront tapas platters and magnum champagne service right as the coastal torches are lit.

faqs.q: How close are Da Nang's beachfront clubs to BRG Da Nang Golf Resort and Montgomerie Links?
faqs.a: Da Nang's premier beachfront clubs along My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap Boulevard sit just 10 to 15 minutes north of BRG Da Nang Golf Resort and Montgomerie Links, and 20 minutes from our private An Bang Beachfront Villas.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for Da Nang's beachfront lounges after a round of golf?
faqs.a: Smart resort casual—such as tailored linen shorts, golf polos, or short-sleeve button-downs with loafers or clean resort sandals—is ideal for transitioning from sunset beachfront cabanas into the 9:00 PM fire show and DJ sets.

faqs.q: Can Asia Golf Specialists reserve private beachfront cabanas and bottle service for an 8-to-12-man golf group?
faqs.a: Yes. We pre-book adjacent oceanfront VIP cabanas and sunken lounge booths with dedicated table service and private return transfers to your Da Nang resort or Hoi An beachfront villa.
